items.title: BLG一穿四夺冠：从说晚安，到说早安
items.en_title: BLG's Four-in-a-Row Title Run: From Saying Good Night to Saying Good Morning
items.en_oneliner: BLG beat Gen.G 3-1 to win the S16 world championship, LPL's first title in five years — a four-match underdog run that became a breakout esports story.

items.title: Slay the Spire 2 has a new character in testing, and she's really quite busted
items.en_title: Slay the Spire 2 has a new character in testing, and she's really quite busted
items.en_oneliner: Slay the Spire 2's new character is in testing, and her kit already looks remarkably overpowered — a useful glimpse at how the indie sequel is approaching character design.
